claim: Attach without capture = gift to distributors. Capture without attach = shrinking pool. Leakage is the measurable gap between the two — and the only dial that moves both.
implication: Do not pitch attach alone (volume theater). Do not pitch capture alone (pool shrink). Pitch leakage-close as the bridge that converts attach growth into capture dollars.
math: Zero leakage → ~$74.5M RR; 50× needs ~1.29× vol. Attach 43% with current capture still leaves most BB$ off-NEAR.
